name: implement a weighted-return dot product matching a reference
definition: Compute the dot product of a weight vector with a returns vector equal to the reference value.

name: implement all-forward-all-backward (AFAB) pipeline scheduling over microbatches
definition: Run forward passes for every microbatch across stages first, then run all backward passes, ensuring no forward pass occurs after a backward pass.
failure_mode: Interleaved forward/backward violates the AFAB ordering check
